decisions.reason: A custom earmold for in-ear systems fits squarely within the firm's core hearing-care business and digital production capabilities, so it is cheap to maintain and likely to stay in the portfolio.
The individual EARsleeve for universal in-ear hearing systems has its own page and serves a growing segment with the firm's established custom-fit know-how, making withdrawal unlikely.
A vacuum thermoforming unit is a durable equipment line that complements the firm's dental and hearing material sales, and such devices are typically kept on the market for many years.
